profile.headline: Software Engineer at Google
profile.summary:
I have experience in Java, Python, Ruby, Rails, HTML, CSS, Javascript (and various popular libraries), MySQL, Solr, Redis, Git, Bash

Specialties: Full-stack engineer specializing in algorithmic coding and scaling solutions, OOP, developing and maintaining code libraries and services, TDD

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
Full Stack development in all aspects of a Rails 3 product in a Unix environment including:
- Bringing core product from a scaffold to alpha stage
- Development of single page web application using backbone.js
- Server side task and deploy scripts
- Adhering to best practices to mitigate technological dept
- Working closely with Founder and Technology consultant to iterate quickly on new features while responding to user input on existing UI.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description: Develop responsive single page data-visualization application in HTML5 using d3, Node.js, Backbone.js, Express, Redis, and MongoDB, as well as internal libraries and tools necessary to prepare data from the internal financial service API for consumption.

positions.title: Javascript Developer
positions.description:
Developing backwards compatible, cross-browser UI behavior.
Implementing front-end solutions for integration with various backend technologies, namely .Net and PHP based solutions.

positions.title: Mobile Web Developer
positions.description: Worked with HTML, Javascript, and the proprietary Tritium language to transform and rebuild web pages optimized for mobile devices.

positions.title: QA Software Engineer
positions.description: Develop software tests for the purpose of exposing and preventing breakage in existing and newly developing code.  Primary support engineer for Python and Ruby API's.

positions.title: Backend Rails Engineer
positions.description: Developed server-side logic and services for a Facebook Application intended to act as a re-branded web portal for the desktop site to increase user base and customer conversion rates.

positions.title: Contracted Programmer
positions.description: Developed scalable programs for handling the calculation of various data-points for large sample sizes and managed the project's steep learning curve well to meet deadlines.
